candidate.claim: GDT827 proposes the fixed eight-whole C0 FLOW model: solkeey=water, okaiin=its, chedy=flows through, qokain=basin, sheedy=if, qokaiin=pipe, chedaiin=is, chealy=open. Its known ZL/IT f77r.35 trial is Dessen Wasser durchfließt das Becken, wenn das Rohr offen ist. It changes five glosses of the inherited transformation account while retaining the same speculative possession and clause arrangement; articles and German reordering are explanatory, not decoded groups. RF has qotaiin and che@152;aiin, so the complete sentence does not transfer unchanged. This model denotes physical flow rather than NETWORK contact between coexisting endpoints. Across the four known ZL-selected windows f75r.32–46, f76r.51–56, f77r.25–37 and f81r.16–31, the f77r.34 repeated pipe still requires a construction and a flowing subject: the preceding pipe cannot automatically supply it. FLOW leaves qol and other non-core words unknown in this isolated comparison without discarding older guesses. Its 42/388 ZL coverage matches TRANSFORMATION because their eight keys coincide; that is coverage, not accuracy or independent semantic support. No complete paragraph or model winner follows, and differing f81r reader boundaries prohibit assuming one shared all-three paragraph.

source_assessment.actual_comparison: The sentence-motivated FLOW map preceded the full paragraph reread but followed knowledge of f77r.35. Four exposed ZL-selected windows were compared with alternate readings retained. No blinded confirmatory comparison or semantic success rate was run.
source_assessment.syntactic_debt: At f77r.34 the repeated qokaiin=pipe cannot silently become two pipes or emphasis. Physical flows-through requires a flowing subject; the preceding pipe does not automatically supply it. Unknown arguments or a separately justified construction might resolve this, so this is an unsatisfied role/construction obligation, not an identified semantic counterexample.
source_assessment.coverage_equality: FLOW and TRANSFORMATION cover the same42/388ZL positions because they use the same eight keys. This exact equality is a coverage identity, not equivalent truth, measured accuracy or a test disproving either content world.
source_assessment.semantic_binding: No independently owned fluid, pipe, basin, direction or caption is identified. The f81r pictured connections do not choose transport versus transformation, and the relevant exact qokain/qokaiin are absent from that selected text. Absence without ownership is neither confirmation nor falsification.
source_assessment.meaning_verdict: No empirical semantic falsification of FLOW and no winner. No broad flow/transport family verdict.

decision_rationale: FE already explicitly states the eight bindings, sentence motivation, shared speculative grammar, alternate-reading limitation, same-key coverage, required flowing subject, repeated-pipe construction, unknown non-core words and source-window boundary limits. A new dossier repeating those clauses would add no distinct tested failure or justified reopening decision. Retain this bounded receipt; do not inflate generic missing-binding memory into a separate failure count.

reopening_assessment.historical_contract: Preserve fixed senses, unknowns and repetitions; compare entire windows, not fluency; no sense drift or proximity ownership. This is exploratory source discipline, not a passed or failed registered semantic threshold.
reopening_assessment.prospective_only: A materially new independently constrained argument/attachment relation could distinguish whether the fixed physical-flow reading has a viable subject and object. New pages alone do not supply that relation; a construction must preserve repeated wholes without silently changing pipe into fluid. This is conditional reasoning only, no approved task or claim that evidence exists.
reopening_assessment.no_automatic_rerun: No new metadata/renderer/decoder, image-ownership search or repeated census is proposed.

evidence.quote:
The motivating ZL/IT source is unchanged:

    solkeey okaiin chedy qokain sheedy qokaiin chedaiin chealy

Two illustrative grammatical German arrangements:

- TRANSFORMATION: Dessen Dampf wird Wasser, wenn die Luft kalt ist.
- FLOW: Dessen Wasser durchfließt das Becken, wenn das Rohr offen ist.

Both require the same speculative possession and clause arrangement; five
of eight exact glosses change together. Both are completions of a known
line, not recovered sentences. Articles and German reordering are explanatory,
not separately decoded groups. RF instead has qotaiin and che@152;aiin, so
neither complete sentence transfers unchanged to that reading.

NETWORK independently proposes outlet/its/joins/channel/where/basin and
leaves the last two wholes unknown. Its relation is contact between coexisting
physical endpoints, not a change of substance or physical liquid flow.

| f77r.34 qokaiin ... chedy ... qokaiin.qokaiin | Air, pipe, foot and basin all remain repeated. No model may turn the last pair into two objects, both feet, or emphasis without a construction. FLOW also needs a flowing subject: the preceding pipe cannot automatically be it. |
| IT f77r.34 qol.chedy after an earlier chedy | In MANUAL, on-it-on; in NETWORK, joins-there-joins. Both inherit a real extra relation, not an erased word. Root's core-only TRANSFORMATION/FLOW leave qol unknown; full inherited extension retains its prior extra becomes debt. |
| f81r.20 qopchedy.qol.chedy.qokeey | Old material-source-becomes-fire; MANUAL unknown-it-on-skin; NETWORK unknown-there-joins-unknown. Different roles, but no model supplies independently identified participants. |
| f75r.35 qokain ... qokain.dar.dar | Under old water/dry this has conditional dry-water pressure. Basin/channel/hand changes remove that particular material restriction, not dar's identity or attachment. No new dar gloss is adopted. |

- f75r.32–46: TRANSFORMATION/FLOW largely offer isolated water/basin and
  one becomes/flows-through contact at .33. MANUAL gains the known central
  action pattern but leaves .34 and .45 fully unknown. NETWORK offers a
  channel at .32/.35/.40/.43 and repeated inlet at .45, not a decoded route.
- f76r.51–56: All models still lack the opening argument identities. MANUAL
  offers press-rub-press at .52 and foot...stroke-skin at .56. NETWORK's
  there at .53 and basin at .56 supply no second connected endpoint. The
  complete .55 remains unknown in all four. No wood/dry hybrid is imported.
- f77r.25–37: The two smooth .35 completions do not explain the opening,
  .29 repetition, .34 doublet or several neighbouring qualification-like
  sequences. MANUAL has rub-rub and on-hand but no complete condition. NETWORK
  has channel-its at .27 and its-outlet-joins-channel at .35 without an owner
  or translated where-tail. None yields a connected complete paragraph.
- f81r.16–31: No exact qokain or qokaiin in any reader here. All four leave
  the opening .16 unknown. TRANSFORMATION/FLOW mainly contribute predicates;
  MANUAL has stroke/press but the on-press collision; NETWORK has spatial
  anaphors without endpoints. The repeated ol groups at .22 remain unknown.

Hauptvergleich4fest: solkeey=Dampf/Becken × chedy=wird/enthält. R sonst gleich,
ol unbekannt; alte Q/humorale und andere Rivalen bleiben separat bestehen.
Enthält meint physischen Inhalt, nie Füllen oder bloße Elementpotenz. Wasser
kann schon enthalten sein oder erst entstehen; das trennt die Sachmodelle.
Becken enthält Wasser plausibel, Becken wird Wasser keine normale Füllung.
Dampf enthält Wasser braucht einen präzisen Stoffbegriff, nicht pauschal unmöglich.

Enthält löst keines der chedy-chedy-Probleme. Wasser steht f75r16/22 auch
vor dem Verb, in einem fortlaufenden Absatz. Eine Zeile ist kein Satzschluss.
F83r9–17 hat Verb-Wasser-Kontakt, aber keinen bekannten Dampf/Becken/Quelle-Kopf.
Die exakten drei Schlussbigrams finden sich nur in f77r35 ZL/IT.

finite Klauselöffnung; beim angesetzten rechtsgerichteten mit-Nominalanschluss
